name: pickup-finder-firebase
description: Firestore rules, indexes, and emulator tests for Pickup-Finder events, sportsmanship ratings, matchmaking, and notification settings

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-pickup-finder "node --import ./tests/register-loader.js --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules.test.js tests/events.test.js tests/sportsmanship-rules.test.js tests/sportsmanship.test.js tests/matchmaking.test.js tests/notifications-rules.test.js tests/notifications.test.js"
